address: 63 Nanzhong Street, North District, Hsinchu City, Taiwan
bio: The decor may feel a little dated, but the room is clean and well maintained. Taiwanese classics are the strong suit here; traditional recipes with authentic local flavours keep diners coming back. Their sautéed beef with scallion stands out for its tender meat and spot-on seasoning. Prompt service keeps the wait time to a minimum. Note that the restaurant has irregular days off, so check their website before heading there.
